name: Dax Merrow
patter: I don't do diligence, I do conviction. Take it, don't take it, I've already tweeted about you.

name: Priya Ansell
patter: We're not investing in your company. We're investing in the version of you that exists in eighteen months, who is frankly more coachable.

name: Gerald Kemp
patter: My nephew explained tokens to me at Christmas. I understood perhaps a third of it. Here, have this, it was going to the boat otherwise.

name: Marisol Quinn
patter: Free of charge, obviously. There's no term sheet. There's no cap table. There is a group chat, and you are now in it.

name: Toby Ng
patter: I founded a company that helps founders found companies. It failed. That makes me an expert on this exact moment in your life.

name: Hollis Frame
patter: I haven't read your deck. I haven't read anyone's deck since 2019. I look at the founder's hands and I simply know.

name: Anneke Vos
patter: Statistically you will fail, and I will be there for that too. Consider this a relationship-building exercise. Take the module.

name: Rune Halvorsen
patter: Everything is a scaling law if you squint. Your rent is a scaling law. Take the free thing and stop asking me about revenue.
